import json, os, random, subprocess, sys
# determinism check across hash seeds via real CLI
rng=random.Random(4)
names=['A','B','C','D']
reg=[{'name':n,'label':l} for n,l in zip(names,[9,3,77,4])]
LIM={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
events=[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'(contains(A,B) or match(C)) allow; endswith(D) drop;'},
        {'op':'stage','epoch':2,'policy':'not(match(A)) allow;'},
        {'op':'commit','epoch':1}]
for i in range(1,20): events.append({'op':'spawn','unit':[0,i,1],'service':names[i%4]})
for i in range(1,20): events.append({'op':'begin','unit':[0,i,1],'rid':i})
events += [{'op':'open','connection':[1,1]},
           {'op':'send','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'destination':'C'},
           {'op':'recv','connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'unit':[0,3,1],'rid':9,'wire':None},
           {'op':'store','unit':[0,3,1],'rid':9,'file':[1,1]},
           {'op':'clone','parent':[0,3,1],'child':[1,3,1]},
           {'op':'inspect'},{'op':'finish','unit':[1,3,1],'rid':9},{'op':'inspect'}]
data=json.dumps({'jobs':[{'services':reg,'limits':LIM,'events':events}]},separators=(',',':')).encode()
outs=[]
for seed in ('0','1','12345', None):
    env=dict(os.environ); env['PYTHONHASHSEED']=seed if seed else str(rng.randrange(10**6))
    env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE']='1'
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/launch.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,env=env,cwd='/workspace')
    outs.append(p.stdout)
    assert p.returncode==0, (p.returncode, p.stderr[:400])
print('all identical:', all(o==outs[0] for o in outs), 'len', len(outs[0]))
print(json.loads(outs[0])['results'][0]['events'][0])
print(json.loads(outs[0])['results'][0]['events'][-2])
EOF
